title: The Labour Taken on a Job a Circle Credit Is Set Against
content:
## The labour taken on the job a Circle credit is set against

Where the charge a Northbeam Circle Membership's benefit credit is set against belongs to a job under
Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair, the standing of that job and the labour charged on it decide
the labour taken.

1. Where the job stands scheduled, dispatched or held for parts and labour has been charged on it in the
   twelve months ending on the handling day, the labour taken is the labour charged on the job in that
   window.
2. Where the job stands completed and labour has been charged on it in that window, the labour taken is the
   labour charged on the job in that window less the service payments booked on it in that window.
3. Where neither of those holds, the labour taken is the least labour billed on that service at its labour
   rate.

## What each amount is read from

The labour charged and the service payments booked are entries on the job itself, counted over the twelve
months ending on the handling day. The least labour billed belongs to the service the job is handled under,
taken at that service's labour rate; it is not a figure of the Circle tier.

## Cases on the three readings

A job standing dispatched with 260.00 of labour charged in the window takes 260.00 as the labour.

A job standing completed with 260.00 of labour charged and 100.00 of service payments booked in the window
takes 160.00 as the labour; where the payments booked in that window came to 260.00, the labour taken comes
to nothing.

A job standing completed with no labour charged in that window, and a job standing in any other way, both
take the least labour billed on that service at its labour rate.
